title: Regions and Celestials
summary: Alfredo has built the Regions and Celestials preview and would like Mendon to review its rules, available actions and player usability.
review_steps: Open Start Review.cmd. The game opens directly to a prepared practice table, with no deck setup needed.
Inspect each player's Regions beside their provinces and Celestials beside Imperial Favor. Check that ownership and card relationships are clear.
Click Low Market and Lady Matsu's Rage. Inspect the full card, offered targets and costs, then try the available actions.
Use the Other previews folder for the opposite seat, a crowded table and normal animation. Each launch starts a fresh fixture.
Use Open Full Game.cmd to inspect the preceding non-duel UI changes and normal Practice. Use Send Feedback.url to record findings on the PR.
known_limitations: Review candidate, not merged or rules-certified. Three automated review findings on PR #292 still need investigation.
This prepared fixture uses real engine actions, manual seats and no automated opponent. It is separate from the pinned Lion/Crane decks.
Includes the preceding non-duel UI stack. The separate Duel Demo is excluded.
Windows graphical play and Mendon's human review remain unverified until he tests this package.
